description:
Legislative history (travaux préparatoires) of a French statute: the
Assemblée nationale and Sénat files, with stages, texts and reports.

Example: get_legislative_history(loi="2016-1547")

Args:
    query: keywords from the file title (French); OR/AND/NOT in UPPERCASE between
        two words are operators; lowercase words are plain words
    loi: statute number ("2016-1547")
    limit: number of files (max 20)
    steps: include the stages of the shuttle between the two chambers
